stages.name: DISPOSABLE_CURRENT_SCHEMA
stages.rule: candidate SQL is installed only on disposable current-schema materializations; canonical migration lists unchanged

stages.name: THREE_CRASH_WINDOWS
tests: after ClayGraph commit before advisory UnifiedDB ACK

stages.name: FULL_DERIVED_REBUILD
stages.test: delete derived graph state and reproduce exact event root + current relation set from retained authoritative history

stages.name: SCHEMA_PROMOTION_CANDIDATE
stages.condition: target gates pass and production projector/backpressure contract exists
stages.action: only then consider adding candidate SQL to apply_current_schema migration lists

stages.name: CANONICAL_MIGRATION
stages.condition: owner-authorized maintenance/recovery gate with last-known-good and selected lineage proof

rollback.before_stage_4: delete/close candidate branch; current production schema unchanged
rollback.after_schema_promotion: explicit migration rollback or rebuild ClayGraph; UnifiedDB authoritative event history remains source
rollback.canonical: restore only an admitted provenance-bound last-known-good under independent recovery rules
